frames to kind of line up."  MEASURED-ONLY: reads bars, writes json, places nothing.

Same grammar as the weekly board, scaled to each timeframe (knobs are placeholders - his numbers owed):
  old bullish BOS line = a pivot top on CLOSES (k bars each side, or a pullback of pullback_pct before anything closed higher), the
  line at the first close within first_pct of the pivot close, later closed above by merge_pct (the BOS), kept as a staircase,
  and only if it stood >= min_stand_bars before its BOS.
  breach / fractal / 50% / zone = fem_f50_zone_scan.fractal() on the bars of that timeframe (latest breach cluster, pokes tolerated).
  bottom fixed (lower frames have no ladder): the swing low is >= swing_confirm bars old AND a higher low has printed since it.
Names = every name with a weekly structure in play (f50_zone_scan.json rows: IN ZONE / no bottom / at the line / above the 50%).
LINED UP = IN ZONE on the weekly AND on the hourly AND on the 15-minute; the table also shows 2-of-3.

Bars: hourly from Polygon (1h aggs, lookback_days, RTH only when rth_only=1), cached in _STUDIES\_bars1h_cache; 15-minute from the
ghost's 15m cache (fem_h4_ladder_ghost.refresh_15m, PRE+RTH, 30 days).
